"speech_act": "promise",
  "conditions_of_satisfaction": [
    "README documents all six subcommands: add, report, list, export, stats, and budget (currently stats and budget are entirely absent)",
verdict.reason: The user only asked to make the README "better," which was undefined, but the agent did not surface that ambiguity or offer selectable improvement directions. It unilaterally chose a documentation-completeness direction and proceeded, so no real agreement about the README improvement was formed.
